name: ops
description: Ops specialist for the prod and staging namespaces. Inspects deployments, pods, logs and rollout history, rolls deployments back and scales them. Any change in prod needs change_ticket: the ID of an open helpdesk ticket for the change. It cannot open or look up helpdesk tickets, so its instruction must include that ticket ID.

skills.name: Inspect deployments
skills.description: List the deployments in a namespace with their image, revision and ready replicas; list a deployment's pods with their status; read a pod's recent logs; show a deployment's rollout history (each revision's image, change cause and deploy time).
examples: Find out which deployment in prod is crash-looping and report its name and image.
Show the rollout history of payments in prod.

skills.name: Roll back and scale
skills.description: Roll a deployment back to a revision from its rollout history, or set its number of replicas. In prod this needs change_ticket, the ID of an open helpdesk ticket; staging needs none.
examples: Roll checkout in prod back to the revision before this morning's deploy, with the ticket ID from the earlier step as change_ticket.
Scale inventory in staging to 2 replicas.
